data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root rabi'a, meaning 'to flow' or 'to rain', and the suffix -ana, meaning 'one who is'. Rubeina means 'Night, Radiant Moon'. The name Rubeina carries the meaning “Night, Radiant Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Rubeina usually hope their child will grow to embody night, radiant moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rubeina total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
